reason: 该插件的主要面向用户功能是面向 DSH 使用场景展示 DeepSeek 账户余额与模型用量/消耗统计，并在主页与设置页提供明细与导出视图，核心是费用与用量监控；分类依据为其通过外部 DeepSeek 服务获取余额、在本机统计并在界面中展示可观测数据，属于外部服务工具化监控能力而非代码生成或调试功能。

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DSH Web 中显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与模型用量和估算费用，并按会话与模型给出可查看与导出的消耗明细。
summaries.en: This plugin shows DeepSeek account balance and model usage/cost estimates in DSH Web, with per-session and per-model consumption details and exportable records.

capabilities: real-time token/event tracking for DeepSeek calls
UI injection into DSH web interface

reasons.code: Reads DeepSeek credentials and queries official balance endpoint `api.deepseek.com/user/balance` for account balance.
Tracks `llm/stream` usage events and computes token buckets and cost estimates in host, which affects billing-related telemetry.
Persists plugin usage data at `$DSH_HOME/dsh-balance-and-cost.json` and exposes reset/export of that data, indicating local file read/write behavior.

capabilities: real-time token/event tracking for DeepSeek calls
UI injection into DSH web interface
